title: internal inference ingress terminator - terraform module for NLB->ALB TLS handoff
creator: Anika Patel
description: Create a reusable Terraform module and rollout plan that implements an internal inference ingress termination pattern: fronting internal services with NLB (TCP) for cross-AZ fast-path and handing off decrypted/decoded TLS traffic to an ALB for L7 routing, structured routing, and WebSocket/HTTP2 support. The module must support SNI-based routing, optional mTLS termination, graceful target group draining, active health probes that exercise the inference runtime (/live, /ready, and a lightweight /warmed probe), and rollout helpers to perform zero-downtime upgrades in VPC/private deployments.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module exposes clear inputs: vpc_id, subnets, customer_tls_cert_arn, enable_mtls (bool as string), sni_map (list of host->target mappings), health_check_path
NLB configured in internal mode (cross-zone) and forwards TCP to ALB via private IPs or TLS passthrough when requested
ALB listeners terminate TLS when configured and set X-Forwarded-For / X-Forwarded-Proto headers; supports HTTP2 and WebSocket routes
Health checks include: TCP-level probe for NLB targets, HTTP /live and /ready on ALB target group with configurable thresholds, and a /warmed endpoint that starts warmup jobs for KV cache
Module includes terraform plan/apply examples and a migration runbook for existing ingress stacks
Automated integration tests run in ephemeral sandbox and validate 99th percentile latency under a 50rps synthetic load profile without increased 5xxs
Security review completed and documented; KMS integration included for cert artifacts when requested
implementation_notes: Use aws_lb (application) and aws_lb_target_group + aws_lb_listener for ALB; use aws_lb (network) separately for the internal NLB with cross-zone enabled
When enable_mtls is true, ALB cannot natively perform mTLS; implement mTLS at the ALB via an NGINX sidecar on targets or leverage AWS Gateway Load Balancer pattern (document trade-offs)
Provide a 'handoff' option: either NLB TCP passthrough + ALB in private subnets with proxy protocol offload, or NLB terminates TLS and re-encrypts to ALB depending on customer requirements
Health-check design: NLB target group with port probe + ALB target group with HTTP checks to /ready; a separate light-weight /warmed endpoint toggles cache warmup job for GPU-backed inference nodes
Support 'session_affinity' variable to optionally enable sticky sessions at ALB target group level for some long-running streaming inference workloads
Terraform providers: require aws provider >= 4.60 and documented provider aliases for multi-account setups
Outputs: alb_arn, nlb_dns, target_group_arns, listener_arns, certificate_arn, healthcheck_dashboard_link
rollout_plan: 1) Deploy module to a sandbox VPC using example config to validate core flows
2) Smoke test: POST /v1/predict on ALB endpoint, validate headers and latency; run health checks for 15 minutes
3) Canary: in target VPC, create new ALB+TG with unique suffix and route 5% of traffic via smart routing rule; monitor 95/99th latency and 5xx rate for 2 hours
4) Gradually increase traffic to 25%/50%/100% while verifying draining behavior on old TGs and that KV warming completes within target time
5) Cutover: switch DNS/CNAME records in private route53 zones (or update service discovery) to point to new ALB; keep old NLB for 1h to absorb stray connections then decommission
6) Post-mortem and follow-up: update docs, capture terraform state changes, and mark module as stable
testing_plan: Unit tests: terraform validate + Terratest Go scripts to create and destroy module resources
Integration tests: use ephemeral infra in CI with mocked inference binary; exercise /live,/ready,/warmed probes and simulate slow startup of backend to test draining
Load test: 50-100rps synthetic load in CI stage using vegeta; measure p50/p95/p99 latency for streaming and non-streaming endpoints
Chaos test: simulate AZ outage by deregistering targets and ensure fallback path via NLB cross-zone works and ALB target health recovers
Security test: run cert rotation flows (rotate certificate ARN) and validate zero-downtime cert swaps
